title: Quake

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · Bethesda Softworks build
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Quake. Steam’s structured release date reflects the digital storefront listing (2007), not the 1996 original retail launch; original release dating remains available for a later curator note if needed.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account and Steam’s ongoing support for the title. Enhanced / remastered clients may depend on additional services.
preservation.concerns: Account-bound digital holdings face platform dependency. Storefront SKUs for classic titles may revise the licensed client in place. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam store release dated August 3, 2007 for this SKU. Quake originally launched in 1996; this accession records the licensed Steam digital edition in custody (id Software / Nightdive Studios / MachineGames).
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and storefront path remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.

steam.shortDescription: Developed by the award-winning id Software, Quake® is the ground-breaking, original dark fantasy first-person shooter that inspires today’s retro-style FPS games. With Quake (Enhanced), experience the authentic, updated, and visually enhanced version of the original.

synopsis: id Software’s Quake on Steam — retained as a permanent digital holding in the Quake series under Bethesda Softworks publication.
